01 / About

Technology.
People.
Execution.

I’m Kaslin Govender, an IT operations professional and founder working across enterprise infrastructure, managed services and a growing group of ventures.

My experience spans endpoint support, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, security and the projects that connect them. I work with support teams, suppliers and business stakeholders to turn technical decisions into reliable day-to-day operations.

Alongside that work, I’m building brands across technology, commerce, mobility, education, travel and community initiatives. Koreplex brings the shared service layer together.
